body.prose: With the whole thing about the object model is that you pull something and then you coexist your own together. You know, do you care about the runs that someone else did? I think the engine you have locally has its own field. It's not mixing with the one which is public. In this case, however, whether it has just projection into what is the field, because the engine has its own state. Whether it actually uses the field well, it does use the field for runs. I would think. Sometimes it projects things also. Like, DB commits, for instance, they aren't actual things in the field per se. Etc.
body.title: Your own field beside the public one
